correctness.rationale: Six-state periodic exclusion process is irreducible for positive rates and |epsilon|<1. Matrix Q(epsilon)=Q0+epsilon Q1 and current rows are explicitly specified. Detailed balance at zero gives pi0=(1,b,b,a,a,ab)/A; solving Q0 pi_k=-Q1 pi_(k-1) with zero-sum normalization yields c1,c2. Full rational stationary solve along b=3/a yields exact c4; positivity of denominators proves complete zero/sign partition. Reflection gives exact oddness on a=1,b=1,a=b; the weak inversion test is excluded elsewhere. The actual verify.py program passed symbolic identities and 18 independent matrix-tree calculations; no finite numerical checks are substituted for the exact proof.

originality.rationale: The published four-rate (2,4,3,41) witness already disproves the general claim that nonsymmetric disorder forces a nonzero quadratic coefficient; that existence statement is NOT claimed here. The non-implied contribution is a complete exact two-contrast family classification, with the factored c2 sign/zero law and a strict quartic lifting formula at every nonsymmetric point on ab=3. Full text of the motivating paper, a prior exact counterexample dossier and its result, plus a later open-system abstract were compared. Search yielded no matching explicit full-family classification; absence in these sources is not a proof of global novelty.
residual_risks: A separately published exact two-contrast classification could exist outside the searched sources; search nonmatches do not establish global novelty.

value.rationale: An exact three-class response stratification for the smallest half-filled exclusion ring quantifies not only if rectification occurs but its precise weak-driving exponent and sign. The adjacent two-contrast disorder family is the minimal nonbaseline pattern able to destroy reflection symmetry on the four-cycle. The accidental cancellation curve ab=3 and its strictly nonzero quartic response reveal a genuine nonlinear transport boundary invisible to symmetry analysis alone. A known isolated counterexample is explicitly excluded from the assessed novelty; the all-parameter structural classification is the valuable content.
